# MCP Registry

Pages base: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools
Raw fallback base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main
Same-origin catalog: data/mcp-registry/api/v1/servers.json
Index: data/mcp-registry/registry.json
Chain: data/mcp-registry/chain.jsonl
Head: data/mcp-registry/orient.json
Each catalog entry uses the official dated MCP server schema.
Capabilities are curated, not an exhaustive inventory of every upstream tool.
Rebuild offline with python3 -B data/mcp-registry/build.py.
manifest.json records the fixed release timestamp and mint-once stream identity.
Edit servers/*.json for catalog updates; advance the manifest timestamp for a new release.
versions/<name>/<sha8><ext> retains immutable content-addressed historical bytes.
